{{Top|leg}}
'''Gel-form''' was an advanced material used in [[Gel-form droid]]s during the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Gel-form was a malleable substance that consisted of a mix of gel and [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]], and was capable of self-repair when supplied with power from an energy source. This made it an excellent material for use in [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]] for snipers.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' {{1st}}
